summary: Design contract for the future read-only Collection Synergy preview screen. Specifies layout, data sources, forbidden actions, accessibility constraints, and Borea hidden handling. NO UI is implemented in CS2-C. NO endpoint is created. NO DB dependency. The contract is the single source of truth for a subsequent implementation task (CS2-D / UI-PREVIEW-B).
preferred_strategy_rationale: Implementing a UI stub today would either (a) require a player-data fetch path that does not yet exist, or (b) duplicate primitives from synergy-codex.tsx. Both increase risk relative to value at this stage. The contract enumerates everything a future safe stub will need, so CS2-D can be implemented straight from this file.

data_sources.purpose: category list + milestone model + cap policy

screen_goals.description: Render the 6 proposed categories from CS2-A as read-only cards with axis + future_runtime_feature_flag visible.
Render owned_count thresholds (3/5/10) + star_threshold optional (5/6) + stacking_rule + caps as a non-interactive panel.
Render max_total <=15 / max_per_category <=5 / applies_to list as a banner.
Every category MUST display a 'Coming Soon' / 'Locked - Future' badge until COLLECTION_SYNERGY_BATTLE_ENABLED is ratified.
Any greek_borea reference is hidden silently; legacy borea / primordial_gaia entries excluded.
Top-of-screen disclaimer: 'Preview only. No bonuses are currently active.'

borea_hidden_handling.rule: greek_borea contributions to any collection synergy must be silently hidden until Borea visibility unlocks. Legacy borea / primordial_gaia permanently excluded.

future_implementation_route_when_safe.must_consume_resolver_via: backend inert read-only endpoint or direct design JSON; NEVER battle_engine

recommended_next_tasks: CS2-D (hypothetical): implement read-only collection-synergies-preview.tsx using design JSON only.
CS2-E (hypothetical): inert read-only API route /api/synergies/collection/preview gated by COLLECTION_SYNERGY_PREVIEW_ENABLED.
CS2-F (hypothetical): accessibility / a11y pass on iPhone 12/13/14 + Galaxy S21.
